refs.purpose: Confirm the collection shapes and labels the resolved data must populate so downstream tests can address them.
refs.trigger: When mapping an input label in the data-flow brief to a concrete file or collection of files.

refs.purpose: Match IWC test-data conventions — Zenodo/remote-URL first, SHA-1 integrity, per-input collection layout — when selecting or describing candidate fixtures.
refs.trigger: When choosing where test data should come from or describing the shape a candidate file must have.

refs.purpose: Output contract: one ref per workflow input, resolved or an honest gap with a reason. Cast bundles the JSON Schema; validate with `foundry validate-test-data-refs` before returning.
refs.verification: Run the test-data-resolution chain on a pinned scenario and confirm each leg's test-data-refs.json validates and implement-galaxy-workflow-test stages from it.

produces.description: Test data matched from IWC fixtures or public sources, expressed as URLs/paths plus expected shapes for downstream test authoring. Carries forward, unchanged, every entry an earlier leg resolved.

consumes.description: Reviewed Workflow Brief when running the brief-driven Galaxy path; mine only its selected input and fixture requirements.

Source summary from [[summarize-paper]] / [[interview-to-freeform-summary]]; mine its sample-data, public-data-candidate, accession, and data-sizing guidance — this is where the source's dataset evidence lives (the design briefs strip it).
Source summary from [[summarize-nextflow]]; mine its test candidate set, explicit selection, and sample-data evidence when running the NEXTFLOW → GALAXY pipeline.
Source summary from [[summarize-cwl]]; mine its test-data / sample-data evidence when running the CWL → GALAXY pipeline.
Galaxy interface brief from [[freeform-summary-to-galaxy-interface]] pinning input labels, collection shapes, and datatypes for the direct PAPER / INTERVIEW → GALAXY pipelines.
Galaxy interface brief from [[workflow-brief-to-galaxy-interface]] pinning input labels, collection shapes, and datatypes for a Workflow-Brief-driven Galaxy path.
Galaxy interface brief from [[nextflow-summary-to-galaxy-interface]] pinning input labels, collection shapes, and datatypes for the NEXTFLOW → GALAXY pipeline.
Galaxy interface brief from [[cwl-summary-to-galaxy-interface]] pinning input labels, collection shapes, and datatypes for the CWL → GALAXY pipeline.

Refs from the chain's source-specific leg ([[nextflow-to-test-data]], [[cwl-to-test-data]], [[paper-to-test-data]]) when the pipeline has one. Keep its resolved entries unchanged and search only for its unresolved inputs. Absent when this Mold is the chain's first leg.
